meta.name: F_p-rational curves · classical · heuristic
meta.regime: Find an isogeny between F_p-rational supersingular curves using small-degree isogenies
meta.rules: The number of F_p-rational vertices is about p^{1/2}, unlike the full F_{p^2} graph. Keep the source random-walk assumptions and GRH connectivity condition; do not mix this easier input restriction with general supersingular curves.
